lane_validation.author: Codex
limitations: Job-hours are summed wrapper wall time, not exclusive box occupancy or CPU-hours.
Full ledger tree plus command is necessary but insufficient proof custody; mutable external inputs, scope, platforms, toolchain and controls still require qualification.
Script-name classes and bounded-log flags do not prove executed scope. Opaque scope is reported, never treated as redundant.
Expected negative controls and distinct required platforms must remain; repeated failures are candidates, not automatic skips.
Repeated-failed-test groups across changing inputs can overlap; hours after two is exposure, never an avoidable-cost sum.
Failure after two is observed only when retained bounded diagnostics match; unknown is not success.

token_audit.operator_reported_account_recovery: 2026-10-25T23:10:00Z; account identity and quota denominator unavailable
limits: Counters cover SDK session histories, not one account or24h spend. Account recovery is coordinator-reported; no credential or account data accessed.
UUIDv7 creation time gives only a session-lifetime wall-hour proxy, not active hours, current burn or account depletion rate.

Observation deltas become available after two comparable corrected snapshots; completion/reporting lag prevents exact spend timing. Missing prior session counters count as newly observed, not proven interval spend.
Branch names are explicit ownership proxies; unmatched PRs, shared work, unmerged proof and roadmap contribution are not assigned. Zero24h matches does not mean a session made no progress.
Legacy resume sums and duplicated *.run.*.log copies overstate inventory. Corrections are accounting changes, not saved model tokens.
